__NOTOC__
<ic>The Empire formally sends invitation to the Commonwealth, the Sarcophan Delves, the Sumaah Republic, and the Axou, to send a delegation to a summit against slavery to be held in the Empire at the Winter Solstice 382YE.<br>''Proposed by Bastion, seconded by Spiral.''</ic>
==Overview==
* A formal statement declaring a summit against slavery to be held at the Winter Solstice 382YE.
* Passed
==Date==
* Summer 382YE
==Outcome==
* Formal notification has been sent to the Commonwealth, Sarcophan Delves, Sumaah Republic, and Axos regarding this invitation.
* The [[ambassador]] to each nation will deal with the details of the invitation.
